original_draft: A retail dataset with 541,909 transactions, cleaned to 18,502 positive purchase invoices from 4,336 known customers. November holdout includes 2,459 active customers and 1,055 repeat purchasers. Logistic regression ROC-AUC is 0.693, average precision 0.666; recency-rule ROC-AUC is 0.553, average precision 0.469. Observational limitations: no campaign lift, no subscriber churn, no streaming behavior, no company-specific performance. No customer consent or contact.
reviewed_example: A retail dataset with 541,909 transaction lines, cleaned to 18,502 positive purchase invoices from 4,336 known customers. November holdout includes 2,459 active customers and 1,055 repeat purchasers. Logistic regression ROC-AUC is 0.693, average precision 0.666; recency-rule ROC-AUC is 0.553, average precision 0.469. Observational limitations: no campaign lift, no subscriber churn, no streaming behavior, no company-specific performance. Consent controls use separate fictional cases; no customer was contacted.
review_notes: Author checked against computed facts. Clarified item lines versus invoices and the separate fictional consent fixture. This saved example is not new browser inference or a correctness certification.
